已完整读取目标 water-lilies-monet-series 正文+FAQ。实际原句 “He commissioned it, then painted the thing he had commissioned.” 。源句 And in the same letter, underlined in the manuscript, comes a sentence that reads very differently now than it did then: \"all the colours that Impressionism has made fashionable are unstable, all the more reason boldly to use them too raw, time will only soften them too much.\" In the decades that followed, another painter organised his materials around a single motif, not a single palette, a programme traced in [Monet's Water Lilies series](/water-lilies-monet-series/). 。核读1893购地申请获准、园工养护、两类构图和约250–300幅范围；源仅称同一水园主题/自己委建，已删除亲自挖池种植的无凭据断言。
